items.label: FUN IN THE TUB
items.value: Brighten up your kids bath with light up bath toys! These soft & squeezable Emergency cars float in water & feature water-safe lights that flash & change colors when contacting water.

items.label: WATER-ACTIVATED LIGHTS
items.value: These tub toys feature water-safe LED lights that flash fun colors on contact with water! Cars flash for 20 seconds, then turn off until re-activated, extending battery life! Battery life 3 months+ with regular use.

items.label: SENSORY PLAY
items.value: Light up toys add a sensory boost to any bath! Emergency cars light-up, flashing multicolored sensory lights when they touch water—a fun sensory adventure with bath lights for kids!

items.label: MOLD-FREE DESIGN
items.value: Our bath toys for kids are sealed to keep moisture out & make clean-up easy! A seamless, no hole design keeps water out, mold away & batteries secure - ideal for light up bath toys!

items.label: SAFE & BABY-FRIENDLY
items.value: Bathtub toys feature water-safe lights, soft PVC and are nontoxic, Phthalate-free & BPA-free! Batteries (nonreplaceable) are securely sealed inside to ensure a safe toddler bath!

items.label: SOFT, SQUEEZABLE & EASY TO GRASP
items.value: Our light-up toddler bath toys are soft, smooth & squeezable, yet durable for long-lasting fun! Perfectly sized water toys for little hands to grasp, hold & play!

items.label: PLAY & EXPLORE
items.value: Spark imaginative play, learn cause-and-effect & create bath games with light-up kids bath toys! Squeezable designs help develop fine motor skills & colorful lights keep kids engaged.

items.label: VERSATILE WATER PLAY
items.value: Light Up Bath Toys are perfect for your kids bubble bath & beyond! Great for use as baby pool toys, water table toys for toddlers, summer toys or any-time toddler water toys!

items.label: IDEAL FOR BABIES & TODDLERS
items.value: Safe, durable & perfectly sized for little hands, our bath lights bath tub toys are great for 6+ Months! Perfect for baby bath toys, bath toys for kids ages 1-3 & beyond!

items.label: EMERGENCY VEHICLES 6 PACK
items.value: Includes (6) exclusive light up bath toys featuring first responders - Police Car, Fire Engine, Ambulance, Helicopter, Tow Truck & Rescue Boat - must-have baby bath toys!
